new_value: Already decided: DTN uses a single Type=0x03 HBH option (Length=5) carrying both the S-flag and absolute expiry. Zero extra bytes — the flags byte is inside the existing option. Spec 05-routing.md lines 967-981 already documents this. The C parser treating 0x03 presence as the store-and-forward indicator is correct behavior. Reserved bits: MUST be zero on send, MUST be ignored on receive (already in spec). No spec or code changes needed.
